Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Vishal Dhagat

On The 15 th Of July, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 18541 of 2024
 Santlal Kol
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Pankaj Kumar Gupta - Advocate for applicant.
 Shri D.K. Paroha - Govt. Advocate for respondent/State.
 Order

This is the first bail application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 on behalf of applicant for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.459/2023, registered at Police Station-Bahri, District-Sidhi (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366A, 376(3) and 376(2)(n) of Indian Penal Code and under Section 3(4), 5L, 6 of POCSO Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix is aged more than 16 years.

In these circumstances,
applicant may be released on bail.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for State opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that in 161 statement she had made allegations of rape.
However, in 164 statement no such allegations are made.
She is minor and aged about 13 years.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.
Offences under Section 363 and 366A is punishable up to 10 years of imprisonment.
Prosecutrix was found in possession of applicant.
Considering aforesaid circumstances, bail application filed by applicant is dismissed.
7. Applicant is at liberty to file repeat application after examination of prosecutrix in Court.
